items.title: Clay Jenkins interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, March 18, 2016
items.q: And especially Bird tunes and Monk tunes.

ctx.x: Do you require them to memorize a certain number of standards?

Yeah. I’m kind of a numbers guy. I like my students to know a lot of tunes. I shoot for a hundred. And that’s a lot. And some of my colleagues say that seems like a — but I’ve learned, as a horn player, when you know some obscure Monk tune and somebody calls their favorite Monk tune and you know it, you’re in the club. And so it really pays off to know, not just harmonies but like — like you might know eight “I Got Rhythm” tunes. But if a guy wants to play “Moose the Mooche” then you’ve got to know the head to…
